root_cause: The public advisor started with technical workload concepts such as tasks per month, tokens and governance toggles, forcing non-experts to understand implementation details before the business problem was understood.
prevention: Start with ordinary business outcomes and usage context rather than model names or token terminology.
Convert cadence and number of users into an estimated workload when volume is unknown.
Use data sensitivity and error impact to adjust quality, governance and human-control guidance.
Allow an understandable unknown/default answer for every technical decision.
fix: Add an outcome-first wizard covering goal, cadence, users, volume, sensitivity, error impact, integration, priority, budget and deployment preference while retaining technical inputs behind an advanced disclosure.
